name: Wizard Signifer Spellmaster
body:
Many hellknight signifers are master arcane spellcasters.

The signifer spellmaster dedicates themselves to the mastery of all arcane magic in the name of the hellknights.

Alignment: A signifer spellmaster must be lawfullyaligned.

Aura of Law (Ex)

The power of a signifer spellmaster’s aura of law (see detect law) is equal to their total character level.

Catechesis (Ex)

A signifer spellmaster is given some training in the religious aspects of the hellknights which gives them a hardened mind and body. The signifer spellmaster gains Warrior Priest as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites. This ability replaces Scribe Scroll.

Signifer Armor Training (Ex)

At 1st level, the signifer spellmaster is used to wearing armor on a regular basis. They reduce the armor check penalty of their armor worn by 1 and the spell failure chance by 5%. This further reduces the penalty by 1 and spell failure chance by 5% at 9th and 17th levels. They are also proficient with any armor with “hellknight” in the name. This ability replaces the initial arcane school abilities and arcane bond.

Signifer Mask (Ex)

At 5th level, a signifer spellmaster has earned the right to bear their signifer mask. They must pass the test and kill a devil single handedly before getting their mask. Once they do, they receive a signifer mask which grants the signifer spellmaster a +2 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks and on saves against visual effects.

Additionally, the signifer mask can be used once per day to cast any one spell that the signifer spellmaster has in their spellbook and is capable of casting, even if the spell is not prepared. This spell is treated like any other spell cast by the signifer spellmaster, including casting time, duration, and other effects dependent on the wizard’s level. This spell cannot be modified by metamagic feats or other abilities.

The signifer spellmaster can add special abilities to their signifer mask as any other wondrous item as if they have the Craft Wondrous Item feat, so long as they meet the level requirements of the feat.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 5th level.

Order (Ex)

A signifer spellmaster must join an order of hellknights.

Discern Lies (Sp)

At 8th level, a signifer spellmaster can use discern lies as a spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to 3 plus their Intelligence modifier.

Their caster level is equal to their class level. This ability replaces the second arcane school ability.

Assiduous Gaze (Su/Sp)

At 10th level and again at 15th level, a signifer spellmaster gains an assiduous gaze ability chosen from the list on page 12. A signifer spellmaster can use each assiduous gaze ability they possess for a number of rounds per day equal to 1/2 their class level. These rounds need not be consecutive.

A signifer spellmaster can activate an assiduous gaze ability as a swift action to examine a single creature, object, or 5-foot square within 30 feet. A signifer spellmaster must be wearing their signifer mask to use these abilities, and their caster level while using them is equal to their class level.

This ability replaces the bonus feats gained at 10th and 15th levels.

Diabolic Harbinger (Su)

At 20th level, as long as the signifer spellmaster wears their signifer mask, they gain telepathy with a range of 100 feet, and can see perfectly in both magical and mundane darkness. While wearing their signifer mask, they are immune to blindness and dazzling effects and gains a +2 bonus on all Charismabased checks when interacting with lawful creatures.

This bonus increases to +4 if the creature is also an outsider. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 20th level.
